titleEn: Coquitlam Kitchen Renovation Cost 2026: Real Prices From $20,000 to $130,000
titleZh: Coquitlam 廚房裝修費用 2026：造價 $20,000 至 $130,000 真實案例
contentEn:
A Coquitlam kitchen renovation costs between $20,000 and $130,000 in 2026, depending on scope. A basic refresh — new cabinet fronts, laminate countertops, and paint — starts around $20,000 to $35,000. A mid-range renovation with custom shaker cabinets, quartz counters, and new lighting runs $45,000 to $75,000. A full gut renovation with structural changes, premium appliances, and a kitchen island can reach $95,000 to $130,000 or more. Reno Stars has completed three published kitchen projects in Coquitlam ranging from a tight-budget refresh to a high-spec quartz-island installation.

Planning a Coquitlam kitchen renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Coquitlam Kitchen Renovation Cost by Scope

Every kitchen project at Reno Stars starts with a free on-site measure and quote. The table below reflects what actual Coquitlam clients paid in 2025–2026, drawn from completed projects.

ScopeEstimated Cost (CAD)What It Includes
Basic refresh$20,000 – $35,000Cabinet refacing, laminate counters, wall paint, updated light fixtures
Mid-range renovation$45,000 – $75,000Custom shaker cabinets, quartz countertops, new sink and faucet, LED lighting, flooring
High-end gut renovation$80,000 – $130,000+Structural changes, premium appliances, waterfall island, custom millwork, hardwood or tile flooring

What Drives the Cost Up in Coquitlam

Coquitlam's hillside terrain and newer subdivisions mean some homes have non-standard cabinet dimensions or structural considerations that affect pricing. A kitchen with awkward angles or older wiring may require an electrician before the renovation can proceed. Permit requirements in Coquitlam are handled by the City of Coquitlam Building Division; most kitchen renovations involving plumbing or electrical work require a permit, and Reno Stars manages the application process.

Reno Stars completed a budget-friendly Coquitlam kitchen for a client who had a tight initial budget but chose to phase the work over two years — starting with cabinet refacing and countertop replacement in year one, then returning for a full appliance upgrade in year two. The phased approach let the client spread costs without compromising on materials quality.

Coquitlam Condo Kitchen: What Is Different

Condo kitchens in Coquitlam — such as those in Burke Mountain, Coquitlam Town Centre, or Austin Heights — face unique constraints. Strata approval may be required before any work begins. There are restrictions on work hours, elevator use for material delivery, and sometimes limitations on plumbing changes. Reno Stars has completed a condo kitchen renovation in Coquitlam that involved quartz countertops and a custom backsplash, navigating strata approvals as part of the project management.

A condo kitchen renovation in Coquitlam typically costs $30,000 to $65,000, depending on whether plumbing modifications are needed and whether the strata permits them.

Materials: What Coquitlam Homeowners Chose in 2025–2026

Reno Stars' Coquitlam clients consistently choose quartz countertops over granite, citing durability and the maintenance-free surface. For cabinetry, shaker-style doors in matte white or light grey are the most popular in Coquitlam kitchens, consistent with the contemporary aesthetic of newer homes in the area. Many clients are specifying soft-close hinges and pull-out organizers as standard features rather than upgrades.

For the kitchen island projects, waterfall quartz edges have become a sought-after feature in Coquitlam whole-home renovations, creating a visual centrepiece that also improves workspace.

How Long Does a Coquitlam Kitchen Renovation Take?

A basic kitchen refresh takes 3 to 5 weeks. A mid-range full renovation typically requires 6 to 10 weeks from demolition to handover. A high-end gut renovation with structural changes can take 12 to 20 weeks. All timelines include permit application time where required; Reno Stars builds the permit timeline into every project schedule.

Client Story: Coquitlam Kitchen with Quartz Island

Reno Stars recently completed a Coquitlam kitchen renovation featuring a waterfall quartz island — one of the most detailed kitchen installations in the portfolio. The project involved custom cabinetry, under-cabinet LED lighting, and a built-in coffee station. The client reported that the island became the natural gathering point in their open-plan living area.

FAQ: Coquitlam Kitchen Renovation

Do I need a permit for a kitchen renovation in Coquitlam?

Most kitchen renovations involving plumbing, electrical, or structural changes require a City of Coquitlam building permit. Cosmetic work such as painting, cabinet refacing, and flooring replacement typically does not. Reno Stars handles the permit application as part of its project management service.

What is the average cost of a kitchen renovation in Coquitlam in 2026?

Based on completed projects, the average mid-range Coquitlam kitchen renovation costs between $45,000 and $75,000. Basic refreshes start at $20,000; premium gut renovations can exceed $100,000 depending on scope and material choices.

How long does a kitchen renovation take in Coquitlam?

A basic refresh takes 3–5 weeks. A mid-range renovation typically takes 6–10 weeks. A full gut renovation requiring structural changes can take 3–5 months, including permit processing time.

What countertop material do Coquitlam clients prefer?

Quartz is the most popular choice among Reno Stars' Coquitlam clients, valued for its durability, low maintenance, and consistent appearance. It resists staining and does not require sealing, making it well-suited to busy family kitchens.

Does Reno Stars offer free quotes for Coquitlam kitchen projects?

Yes. Every Reno Stars project begins with a free on-site measure and a detailed quote. The on-site visit ensures accurate dimensions and allows the team to identify any site-specific considerations before pricing.

Ready to plan your Coquitlam kitchen? Contact Reno Stars for a free, no-obligation quote.

什麼因素會提高 Coquitlam 廚房裝修費用

Coquitlam 公寓廚房：有何不同

Coquitlam 公寓廚房——如 Burke Mountain、Coquitlam Town Centre 或 Austin Heights 的單位——面對獨有限制。施工前可能需要業主立案法團審批。工作時間、材料電梯運輸以至水管改動均受限制。聚星裝修曾在 Coquitlam 完成一間公寓廚房裝修，涉及石英石枱面及定制瓷磚廚房防濺板，並代表客戶處理了業主立案法團的審批程序。

Coquitlam 公寓廚房裝修通常需 $30,000 至 $65,000，視平房是否有水管改動及法團是否批准而定。

材料：2025–2026 年 Coquitlam 住戶的選擇

聚星裝修的 Coquitlam 客戶一致選擇石英石枱面而非花崗岩，原因是石英石耐用且無需保養，表面均勻美觀。廚櫃方面，啞光白或淺灰色的鄉村風門板在 Coquitlam 住宅中最受歡迎，與當地較新樓盤的現代風格一致。許多客戶將緩衝鉸鏈及拉出式收納架列為標準配置，而非升級選項。

至於廚房中島項目，瀑布式石英石邊緣已成為 Coquitlam 全屋裝修中的熱門功能，既提供視覺焦點，亦增加工作空間。
